Describe the reader-facing change and the evidence supporting it.

- [ ] Factual claims cite original sources; interpretations and examples are labeled.
- [ ] Event, publication, and substantive update dates are accurate.
- [ ] Authorship, AI assistance, and relevant affiliations are disclosed.
- [ ] News review record identifies the actual reviewer and checks performed.
- [ ] Material corrections include a visible note and revision-log entry.
- [ ] `npm test`, `npm run check`, and browser checks pass.
- [ ] Only `dist/` is proposed for deployment; subdomains and archives remain outside this release.
